_comment: Licenses for packages that ship no license text of their own, and for third-party
code compiled into prebuilt binaries so it never appears in the npm tree.
Every entry needs a note saying where the text or the claim came from. A package that
publishes no license file is not a package whose terms can be guessed at, so the
answer has to be traceable to somewhere — its source repository, or its own
package.json where that is all there is.
scripts/notices.js reads this file. Adding a dependency that lands here without an
